subgoals.goal_text: Since the party has fainted members (Oddish and Diglett), return to Vermilion City and heal at the Pokemon Center.
Enter the Rock Tunnel from Vermilion City.
Traverse the Rock Tunnel and exit on the east side to Route 10.
Travel from Route 10 to Route 12. Note: Saffron City is blocked, so the path must go around via Route 11 and 12.
Travel north from Route 12 to reach Lavender Town.
